---
title: "Step 3. Read your level"
description: "Read your level where your impact and likelihood scores meet."
---

Do this in [Phase 2, design](../02-design/index.qmd). If an impact dimension scored 4, go to [Business Critical analysis](../08-business-critical/index.qmd).

Take your highest impact score from [Step 1, score the impact](score-the-impact.qmd). Take your highest likelihood score from [Step 2, score the likelihood](score-the-likelihood.qmd). Read your level where the two meet.

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-assurance-level-matrix.qmd >}}

| Impact | Likelihood 1 low | 2 moderate | 3 high | 4 very high |
|------------------|--------------------|--------------------|--------------------|----------------------|
| **4 very high** | Level 4 BCA | Level 4 BCA | Level 4 BCA | Level 4 BCA |
| **3 high** | Level 1 Standard | Level 2 Enhanced | Level 3 Comprehensive | Level 3 Comprehensive |
| **2 moderate** | Level 1 Standard | Level 2 Enhanced | Level 2 Enhanced | Level 3 Comprehensive |
| **1 low** | Level 1 Standard | Level 1 Standard | Level 1 Standard | Level 2 Enhanced |

: The assurance level for each combination of impact and likelihood score

Each level includes the checks of every lower level.

Read your level from the matrix. Do not choose a level because time is short.

An older NHSBSA document may say Tier where this says Level. They map one for one: Tier 3 is Level 3 Comprehensive.

## What your level means

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-what-changes-as-the-level-rises.qmd >}}

| Level | What it is for | What else you do |
|---|---|---|
| **Level 1 Standard** | Low risk analyses, and analyses where there is very limited time to assure | Write down enough to re-run it |
| **Level 2 Enhanced** | Moderate risk analyses, and analyses with very limited time if time permits | Name your reviewer before you start. Log the checks. Write a quality assurance statement |
| **Level 3 Comprehensive** | High risk analyses, and analyses with very limited time if time permits | Carry out full verification and validation |
| **Level 4 BCA** | Very high risk Business Critical analyses | Add formal audit, and follow [Business Critical analysis](../08-business-critical/index.qmd) |

: What each assurance level is for, and what you do beyond what the picture shows

Very limited time does not lower your level. The tool says to carry out the Level 1 checks, add the others where time permits, and record what was left out. See [when there is not enough time](after-you-have-your-level.qmd#when-there-is-not-enough-time).

### Independence applies at every level

The assurer and the analyst shall be independent. See [how independent you have to be](../06-roles/critical-friend.qmd#how-independent-you-have-to-be) for how far apart they must be at your level.

You still assure your own work at every level. There shall also be formal independent assurance.

## NHSBSA's worked examples for impact

NHSBSA marks these examples as still to be developed. Read your level from the matrix, using your own likelihood score.

| Impact | NHSBSA's examples | Levels it can give |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| **4** | Funding allocation formula, eligibility model, payment methodology, major policy appraisal | Level 4 BCA, at every likelihood |
| **3** | Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Dental Statistics, Freedom of Information (FOI) response, Board report, ministerial briefing | Level 1 Standard to Level 3 Comprehensive |
| **2** | Monthly operational dashboard, team workforce planning | Level 1 Standard to Level 3 Comprehensive |
| **1** | Exploratory analysis, internal data investigation | Level 1 Standard or Level 2 Enhanced |

: NHSBSA examples of work at each impact score, and the levels it can give

Score your own work. Do not match it to the nearest row.

Do not score a Board report, FOI response or ministerial briefing at impact 4 on visibility alone. See [what does not, by itself, justify Level 4](score-the-impact.qmd#what-does-not-by-itself-justify-level-4).
